race.comment: Tough race with plenty of chances. VARJAK (2) comes out of a strong contest when returning with an eye-catching third from back in the field over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Clearly strengthened over the break and can hold a forward position today. BEAUTIFUL YOU (12) impressed on debut with a fighting on-pace second to Harry Lime over 1200m at Wyong. Bounced off that effort with a commanding win over 1400m at Canberra from the rails draw. Gets a similar set up again and sure to be thereabouts. DIRTY SUMMER (3) is smart on his day and will relish the claim again third up. Forced to work hard in the run and never shirked his task to run a close fourth over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Likely to push forward here from the sticky barrier. Each-way. ZONKSTAR (5) rounded up a decent Super Maiden field on debut to salute at Newcastle over 1400m six-and-a-half weeks ago. Kept up to the mark with a recent trial placing over 1200m at Gosford. Leading contender.
